exact_reason: The independently reconstructed advancement values retain full floating-point precision, while advancement.json was written by pandas to_json at approximately ten decimal digits. The verifier's 1e-12 record-comparison threshold therefore rejects the saved rounded values. No predictive/result file was modified to address the mismatch.
